step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates an automated migration workflow from on-premises to AWS. 1. The Migration Team interacts with Slack and populates migration metadata into DynamoDB. 2. On-premises servers send connection/performance metadata to Application Discovery Service and block-level data to the EC2 Hot Replica. 3. Slack commands trigger the Migration Factory EC2 instance. 4. The Migration Factory calls Application Discovery Service and CloudEndure (which manages the EC2 Hot Replica) to stop replication and bake an AMI. 5. The AMI is created ('Bake AMI'), encrypted and shared to the target account ('Shared AMI'), and used to launch the target EC2 instance in the target account.
